entry.name: FavoriteApps
entry.label: Dash favourites (desktop file ids), used only when FavoritesClient is empty or the Plasma favourites model cannot be loaded.

entry.name: FavoritesClient
entry.label: KActivities favourites client shared with the launcher, e.g. org.kde.plasma.kickoff.favorites.instance-N, N = the Kickoff applet id (set by install.sh). Empty: use FavoriteApps.

entry.name: UnpinFromTaskManager
entry.label: Unpinning an app in the dash also removes it from the pinned launchers of the panel task manager(s), live through plasmashell. Pinning never adds to the task manager.

entry.name: HideFavoritesInGrid
entry.label: Like GNOME, don't show dash favourites in the app grid and folders.

entry.name: DashIconSize
entry.label: Largest dash icon size in px (GNOME: 64); smaller GNOME sizes are used if the dash does not fit.

entry.name: SearchFocusReturnMs
entry.label: Milliseconds after the last arrow key in the search results before the text cursor returns to the search entry (the highlighted result stays selected). 0 = off (GNOME).

entry.name: BackgroundTint
entry.label: Opacity of the dark tint over the blurred wallpaper, in percent (only with BlurBackground).

entry.name: IconScale
entry.label: Multiplier for app grid / dash icon sizes (1.0 = GNOME sizes).

entry.name: IconSize
entry.label: App grid icon size in px (0 = GNOME's automatic 96/64/48... sizes). Steps down if the grid does not fit.

entry.name: Columns
entry.label: App grid columns (0 = GNOME's automatic 8x3/6x4/4x6/3x8 modes).

entry.name: Rows
entry.label: App grid rows (0 = automatic, from the screen shape).

entry.name: AppLayout
entry.label: Saved app grid order (desktop ids, folders as folder:Name). Written by the overview.

entry.name: HotCorner
entry.label: Screen corner that toggles the overview: 0 none, 1 top-left (GNOME), 2 top-right, 3 bottom-left, 4 bottom-right.

entry.name: MetaCycle
entry.label: What pressing Meta alone does ("Cycle GNOME Overview" action): cycle = 1st press window picker, 2nd app grid, 3rd closes; toggle = GNOME, a second press closes.

entry.name: DynamicWorkspaces
entry.label: GNOME dynamic workspaces: always one empty desktop at the end, empty desktops are removed, dropping a window or app between workspace thumbnails creates one.

entry.name: GestureFingers
entry.label: Fingers for the up/down touchpad swipes (0 = off): up = window picker, again = app grid; down goes back. Needs the built-in Overview off when 4.

entry.name: AppFolders
entry.label: App folders as "Name=id1;id2;..." (desktop file ids). Empty: built-in Utilities and System folders.

entry.name: ImplDir
entry.label: Implementation directory under contents/ui (written by install.sh)

entry.name: Backend
entry.label: auto, module, local or kicker

entry.name: DevHooks
entry.label: Development only: run DevScript (dev/drive.sh) inside the effect.

entry.name: DevScript
entry.label: Development only: JS run when this value changes and DevHooks is on.
